verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service, so asking whether an agent can post journal entries through an API into an accountant review queue is a fair question. The evidence shows no public API: OpenAPI and llms.txt probes return 404, and the customer-facing surface is reports and downloads rather than a ledger the customer posts to. Customer actions are limited to categorization help and one-click requests to a human bookkeeper, with no programmatic journal-entry drafting or review queue.
